title: He makes cakes for other families. Now he wants time with his own

blocks.text: Forest Lawn Bakery — a long-standing family business in Calgary — has closed after over 30 years. Owner Danny La estimates he has made more than 70,000 cakes over the past 25 years, often sacrificing time with his own family to keep the business running. After decades of hard work, he’s reflecting on what matters most.
